author: Brandon Sanderson
coverage: core viewpoints and premise; not exhaustive cast or scene-by-scene adaptation

viewpoint_characters.name: Raoden
viewpoint_characters.description: A prince confined to the ruined city after transformation.

viewpoint_characters.name: Sarene
viewpoint_characters.description: A princess navigating a political marriage and Arelon’s vulnerability.

viewpoint_characters.name: Hrathen
viewpoint_characters.description: A missionary pursuing conversion under an imperial threat.

proposed_adaptation.logline: A confined prince, a newly arrived princess and a driven missionary confront a kingdom’s crisis from opposing positions.
proposed_adaptation.pacing: Alternate the city’s survival problem with political and religious pressure; converge the viewpoints rather than treating one as the entire story.
proposed_adaptation.era: invented world; do not assign a real historical year
proposed_adaptation.character_policy: editable ensemble; do not force Hoid as lead or flatten Hrathen into a fixed one-note role

import_behavior: preview and merge; preserve player edits; never replace missing canon with generic roles
